stories.title: Turned tutor behavior into a versioned, operable system.
stories.body: The work spans the prompt service, dashboard UI, and AI Tutor runtime: immutable tutor-version snapshots, org-scoped prompts, editable drafts, runtime client wiring, defaults, import/export, and rollback switches.

stories.title: Built the path from school identity to live classroom workflows.
stories.body: This was not just a login button. It covered Clever schema and mappings, roster sync, Canvas publish/update/delete, LTI launch context, grade/progress writeback, diagnostics, feature flags, and sandbox runbook repair.

stories.title: Closed risky edges in auth, access, sockets, and deployability.
stories.body: The recurring pattern is boring in the best way: remove legacy paths, harden assigned-lesson access, make websocket auth survive real cookies, add API access controls, pin live env behavior, and guard Alembic drift.

stories.title: Kept four busy repos moving through production safely.
stories.body: A large part of the contribution was integration work: release PRs, production backmerges, merge-freeze guardrails, pipeline fixes, Lambda packaging hardening, and production/development syncs across the product surface.
